recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add careteam-alias to core; if FHIR-53009 is later accepted, handle that as Extension Pack work and then reassess downstream search expression typing if needed.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Patient Care request, raised in STU3 and applied for R5, to add a CareTeam name search parameter and a 0..* string alias extension so name search covers both CareTeam.name and alias.
initial_application: 3eafc4b added the CareTeam.name search parameter and alias extension spreadsheet material, bc099d7 updated the CareTeam profile for the alias extension, and 1b49161 updated the current XML search parameter source with J#20012 and an alias-inclusive expression. dd468d4f later removed core extension definitions during the R5 extension migration.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/careteam/bundle-CareTeam-search-params.xml is in build scope. The current SearchParameter expression is CareTeam.name | CareTeam.extension('http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/careteam-alias').value. The Extension Pack defines careteam-alias as the requested CareTeam-scoped string extension. FHIR-53009 is only a Submitted Extension Pack proposal to change the alias value type, and FHIR-42838 is a separate NDH IG correction outside FHIR-core.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current in-build core source already satisfies the search-parameter request and the alias extension's absence from core is expected after migration to the Extension Pack.
